description: Blind-crest two-way corridor (edge case 06) instantiated on richmond-field-station: 4 moving actors replayed from the render timeline (scene-state.v1 at 24 fps, baked XODR heights, road + body attitude) through scen-play --authored-height. Gates: pass hashes, a non-vacuous instance-ID pass, and observed actor transforms within the Bevy parity profile of the timeline sampler. Two-wheelers are drawn without their rider (--allow-riderless-two-wheelers, recorded as actor-model-substitution): scen-play draws rigid parts and cannot pose the skinned rider, so this golden keeps guarding the bike geometry; the ridden look is covered by native-render-service.
